Score learning per participant

Source: R/fba-learning.R
score_learning.Rd

Counts the trials, responses and correct responses of every participant in every block of every learning stage, separately for each contingency type. The results represent the per-participant, per-type summaries on which the learning checks and the learning-based exclusion rules are based.

Usage

score_learning(x, silence = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A catlas_rawdata object.

silence

Logical(1). Suppress the message summarising what data went into the calculations. Defaults to FALSE (recommended).

Value

A tibble with one row per participant, stage, contingency type and block, and columns:

id

Participant identifier.

stage, type, block

As in the trials component.

n_trials

Number of trials presented.

n_timed_out

Number of trials that ended without a response.

n_responded

Number of trials with a recorded response.

n_correct

Number of correct responses.

p_correct

n_correct / n_responded, or NA when no trial was answered.

Details

Stages

Only the stages that give feedback according to the study design are used during the calculations. The design can be found in the provenance(x). The test stage is never included, because in it, the is_correct column records whether a response is consistent with blocking, which is a component part of the outcome measure of the study, rather than a measure of learning.

Timed-out trials

Timed-out trials are left out of the denominator of p_correct and counted in n_timed_out instead, so that leaving the task is not confused with giving an incorrect answer.

Messages

Every call states which stages were scored and how many timed-out trials were left out of the denominators, unless manually silenced (silence = TRUE).

See also

aggregate_learning(), plot_learning()
